title: News
subtitle: A pause to discover ideas and keep learning.
not_updated: No successful source check has been recorded yet.
load_error: We could not load the news. You can retry reading it.
source_refresh_error: The latest source refresh failed. Available news has been preserved.
empty: There is no news to show yet
empty_description: News will appear here when the administrator refreshes the sources.
filtered_empty_description: Try another topic or return to all sources.
excerpt_notice: Shortened excerpt presented as plain text.
reading_notice: Reading and filters use saved news. Articles open on their original websites.
invalid_response: The news response does not have the expected format.
super_admin_required: Only a superadministrator can refresh news.
refresh_in_progress: A news refresh is already in progress.
refresh_superseded: This refresh no longer controls the result. Check the saved news.
source_unavailable: The source is unavailable. Previous news has been preserved.
source_timeout: The source did not respond in time. Check its status before attempting another refresh.
source_rate_limited: The source asks us to wait before requesting it again.
unsafe_destination: The source destination did not pass the security check.
response_too_large: The source returned a response larger than the allowed limit.
invalid_feed: The source did not return a valid news feed.
source_refresh_error_named: The latest refresh of {{source}} failed. Available news has been preserved.
